waystone_cache.title: Waystone Cache
waystone_cache.text:
A hollow beneath a cracked waystone holds a traveler's purse,
abandoned long enough that the leather has gone green.

choices.label: Take the purse
choices.outcome: Coin is coin. The dead road keeps no ledger.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.outcome: Some debts are not worth learning the terms of.

withered_shrine.title: The Withered Shrine
withered_shrine.text:
An old shrine to a forgotten warden of the woods. Its bowl is dry,
but the stones still hum when you lay a coin in it.

choices.label: Offer 30 gold
choices.outcome: Warm light threads through your wounds and knits them shut.

choices.label: Offer 80 gold
choices.outcome: The bowl fills with light and will not stop filling.

choices.label: Move on
choices.outcome: The shrine's hum fades behind you like a held breath.

abandoned_wagon.title: Abandoned Wagon
abandoned_wagon.text:
A merchant's wagon lies on its side, one wheel still turning.
Whatever took the drivers took nothing else.

choices.label: Search the wreck
choices.outcome: You pry the strongbox loose and shake it empty.

choices.label: Keep your distance
choices.outcome: That wheel had no wind to turn it. You walk wide.

blood_altar.title: The Blood Altar
blood_altar.text:
A basalt slab, dark-stained and older than the orcs. The carvings
are plain enough: strength, paid for in the usual currency.

choices.label: Pay the price
choices.outcome: The stone drinks. Something old and approving looks back.

choices.label: Open every vein (party -30% health, +1 point each)
choices.outcome: Four hands on the stone. It drinks from all of you and teaches all of you.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: The altar waits. It has always waited. It will keep waiting.

cursed_idol.title: The Cursed Idol
cursed_idol.text:
A squat golden idol grins from a pedestal of stacked skulls.
It is heavier than gold should be, and warmer.

choices.label: Take it (+80 gold, party -10% max health)
choices.outcome: The grin widens a fraction. Surely a trick of the light.

choices.label: Take the whole hoard (+200 gold, party -20% max health)
choices.outcome: You carry it out in both arms. Something in you sags to make room.

choices.label: Leave it grinning
choices.outcome: Gold that smiles is rent, not treasure.

forest_spring.title: The Old Spring
forest_spring.text:
Clear water rises through roots that predate the Decay.
The rot has not found this place. Yet.

choices.label: Drink deep
choices.outcome: The water tastes of a morning from before all this.

choices.label: Press on
choices.outcome: Clean water in a rotting wood. You trust nothing here.

scarland_mirage.title: Scarland Mirage
scarland_mirage.text:
Across the ash flats shimmers a caravan that is not there —
yet its strongbox glitters with a weight that might be.

choices.label: Chase it
choices.outcome: The heat taxes you sorely — but the strongbox was real.

choices.label: Run it down (party -25% health, +190 gold)
choices.outcome: It breaks at the last stride and leaves its coin behind out of spite.

choices.label: Let it shimmer
choices.outcome: The Scarlands sell nothing an honest walker can afford.

old_trapper.title: The Old Trapper's Camp
old_trapper.text:
A cold camp, expertly hidden. Your Survivalist reads the signs
in a glance: the owner is three days dead in a ditch somewhere.

choices.label: Scavenge it properly
choices.outcome: Wire, powder, salves — the trade tools of a careful ghost.

choices.label: Leave the camp be
choices.outcome: Trapper's honor. The woods will take it back.

arcane_obelisk.title: The Humming Obelisk
arcane_obelisk.text:
A shard of black stone leans out of the earth, wrapped in slow
blue script. Only your mage can read what it is offering.

choices.label: Let the mage commune
choices.outcome: The script crawls up their arm and settles in like a pact.

choices.label: Pull them away
choices.outcome: Stones that write back are nobody's friend.

deserters_stash.title: Deserter's Stash
deserters_stash.text:
Under a floorboard in a burned watchpost: a soldier's pay,
a sealed potion, and a note that simply reads 'I'm sorry.'

choices.label: Take the stash
choices.outcome: Whoever they were, they ran lighter than they planned.

choices.label: Leave it for their ghost
choices.outcome: Some apologies should keep their collateral.

plague_victim.title: The Withering Pilgrim
plague_victim.text:
A pilgrim slumps at the roadside, grey threads of the Decay
crawling up their neck. They wave a heavy purse with a shaking hand.

choices.label: Help them (one hero risks the rot)
choices.outcome: You carry them to cleaner air. The rot tithes your helper.

choices.label: Spend your medicine on them (-1 Health Potion, +90 gold)
choices.outcome: They press a dead lord's signet into your hand and will not take it back.

choices.label: Walk past
choices.outcome: The purse sags. The road teaches hard arithmetic.

training_grounds.title: Ancient Training Grounds
training_grounds.text:
Weathered practice posts stand in a perfect circle. The old
drill-masters charged for wisdom in their day. Their echoes still do.

choices.label: Pay 60 gold and drill
choices.outcome: By dusk one of you moves differently. Sharper. Older.

choices.label: Pay 150 gold and drill the whole party
choices.outcome: Four days of forms in one afternoon. Everyone limps. Everyone is better.

choices.label: Save your coin
choices.outcome: The posts creak their disappointment as you go.

wardens_echo.title: Echo of the Warden
wardens_echo.text:
The trees here grow in the Warden's image, and dream its dreams
aloud. Listening is knowledge. Listening is also listening back.

choices.label: Listen
choices.outcome: Visions batter you — and buried in them, the Warden's guard drops.

choices.label: Let it in (one hero -35% health, and a rune)
choices.outcome: It speaks through one of you, and leaves something written on the inside.

choices.label: Cover your ears
choices.outcome: Whatever the wood is dreaming, you decline the invitation.

mushroom_ring.title: The Mushroom Ring
mushroom_ring.text:
Fat red-capped mushrooms grow in a ring wide enough to camp in.
Every forager's tale you know starts exactly like this.

choices.label: Eat the strange mushrooms
choices.outcome: One of you sees briefly through time. Their hands stop shaking.

choices.label: Camp outside the ring
choices.outcome: The ring keeps its counsel. You keep your senses.

collectors_grave.title: The Collector's Grave
collectors_grave.text:
A grave-marker of stacked curios: a magpie soul, buried with
everything it loved. Grave-dirt this old resents a shovel.

choices.label: Dig (the dead object)
choices.outcome: Cold hands rake you as you lift the collector's prize free.

choices.label: Pay the caretaker 120 gold
choices.outcome: He takes the coin, looks at nothing, and points at a stone.

choices.label: Respect the grave
choices.outcome: Whatever glitters down there, it was loved once. Leave it.

fallen_cairn.title: The Cairn of the Fallen
fallen_cairn.text:
A cairn raised for soldiers of an older war. The stones remember
what it is to have died for someone — and what it costs to return.

choices.label: Lay your dead upon the stones
choices.outcome: The cairn takes their silence and hands back their breath.

choices.label: Carry them onward
choices.outcome: Not every mercy is owed to strangers' stones.

ashfall.title: Ashfall
ashfall.text:
The sky comes down as grey grit. It gets into the eyes, the
wounds, the water. There is nowhere here to shelter.

choices.label: Push through it
choices.outcome: You walk out of it coughing, a little less than you walked in.

cutpurse.title: The Cutpurse
cutpurse.text:
A thin figure keeps pace with you for half a mile, then does not.
So does a quarter of the purse.

choices.label: Count what is left
choices.outcome: No blood, no fight, no chase worth having. Just less.

spoiled_stores.title: Spoiled Stores
spoiled_stores.text:
Something got into the packs in the night and was not fussy.
Two of the flasks have gone to green sludge.

choices.label: Pour them out
choices.outcome: The smell follows you until noon.

wormrot.title: Wormrot
wormrot.text:
The road here is soft, and it breathes. Whatever lives under it
takes a little from everyone who crosses — not enough to stop for.

choices.label: Cross it anyway
choices.outcome: Nobody falls. Everybody is a little smaller on the other side.
